subject.title: [Feature]: Make managed browser launch degrade cleanly when no display server is available

question: Should explicit headed no-display browser failures expose a stable structured route/client error, and what fields should be part of that contract?
rationale: Current code already detects the condition; the unresolved choice is the stable browser service/client error contract and whether any explicit-headed fallback policy is allowed.

options.title: Add structured error
options.body: Keep explicit headed requests fail-closed and add a closed reason plus typed details while preserving the existing human-readable message.

options.title: Add opt-in fallback policy
options.body: Introduce a documented profile policy that can downgrade headed to headless in no-display environments, with upgrade and service-context proof.

options.title: Keep text-only behavior
options.body: Treat the current actionable message as sufficient and leave automation callers without a stable branchable reason.

recommendation.title: Add structured error
recommendation.body: Keep explicit headed requests fail-closed and add a closed reason plus typed details while preserving the existing human-readable message.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to steipete and history ties him to the bundled browser route/client surface.
